header.rule: Bridge for two. The first 13 tricks are a no-trump draw: winning one scores nothing, and after each trick the winner then the loser draws a card. Once the 26-card stock is gone both hands are back to 13 and the auction begins. A contract needs 6 + level tricks.

tutorial.draw: The first 13 tricks **do not score**. They are played without trumps, and after each one **the winner draws first, then the loser**. 13 x 2 = 26 empties the stock exactly, leaving both hands back at 13 cards.
tutorial.bid: Once the stock is gone, the auction runs. **Levels 1-7 across five denominations (S < C < H < D < NT)**, and a bid has to outbid the table. **No-trump is the strongest**, so it sits above diamonds at the same level. Two passes in a row close the auction.
tutorial.contract: A contract needs **6 + level** tricks. Making it scores level x 10 plus 5 per overtrick; going down hands the opponent **10 per trick short**.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Cards you may legally play get a green ring.
